fields.description: Issue features a front-page report and editorial coverage alleging Miami Beach City Manager Renshaw faces potential legal action over alleged misappropriation of public funds/materials and his role in protecting a gambling syndicate, alongside discussion of police department authority and city council efforts to curb syndicate influence. Additional editorials and letters address Florida politics and taxation (opposition to a state sales tax and commentary on Gov. Fuller Warren), grand jury and Dade County governance issues, and a column noting federal action to ban certain radio giveaway programs. The issue also includes local public-safety reporting on hurricane warning broadcasts, health and consumer items (including dental product claims), and extensive Miami Beach nightlife/entertainment coverage and advertising.
